acceptanceCriteria: A paired benchmark against the V1-0645 baseline shows a measured saving, recording host, load and run count.
The mapped-write test TestCALV0070_MutateRefusesMappedWriteAfterMergedAudit still fails closed.
body: Proposed 2026-10-05 by the V1-0645 lane (e9001205). After the r2 mapped-write fix, every Mutate takes a fresh inventory, and reuses the merged audit only when each audited file matches by digest and size. Pinning or caching the inventory's file reads (for example by open-file identity plus size/mtime, verified by digest) could recover part of the cost the fix adds back. V1-0645 measured median Mutate at 5,494→3,151 ms on macOS and 4,019→2,547 ms on Linux with the fix in place.
title: store: pin inventory reads now that every Mutate takes a full fresh inventory
